text:
Alex K: ALERT: incident 2099012345 — canary regression detected for model-serving (v2.4.0-canary) in us-west-2. Error rate up and 95p latency spike. Paging oncall.

deploy-bot: [incident-bot] Paging oncall: incident 2099012345 — canary errors > 5% over baseline for 10m. Links: https://ci/reports/2099012345

Alex K: Taking this — status: triage. Joining: @Maria L @Sam T. Initial asks: customer impact, canary vs baseline diff, and any recent infra/driver changes.

Maria L: reading canary diffs now. quick note: canary introduced a new quantization profile q3a + a kernel fallback change from PR #5128.

Sam T: logs uploaded: s3://redwood-logs/canary/2099012345/ and kibana dashboard https://kibana/siem/canary-2099012345

Alex K: Customer impact: alerts show ~2% of hosted traffic routed to canary and 3 dedicated customers in us-west-2 seeing elevated 5xx/timeouts. Not global but high-severity for those tenants. (cc: @Jordan P for customer comms)

Jordan P: On it — drafting a short customer status: "Investigating model canary; partial degradation for select customers in us-west-2; mitigation in progress. No data exfiltration."

Maria L: quick config diff (canary vs pinned):
```
- quant_profile: q2
+ quant_profile: q3a
- kernel_flags: flash_attn_v2
+ kernel_flags: auto_fallback
```
I suspect q3a + auto_fallback changes execution path and increases latency and retried requests.

Alex K: Hypothesis tracker (will update):
1) q3a quantization degrades performance for long sequences -> latency/timeouts.
2) auto_fallback kernel selection triggers slower kernels on some GPUs -> elevated p95.
3) routing misconfiguration overloaded some hosts in canary cohort.
4) upstream driver/runtime change incompatible with fallback kernel -> transient errors.

Sam T: error sample from inference logs:
```
2026-05-03T12:34:12Z ERROR inferer: request_id=abcd1234 status=504 reason=\"kv-cache timeout\" model=v2.4.0-canary host=i-0abc
2026-05-03T12:34:13Z WARN runtime: kernel_fallback: using generic_attention slower path
```

logs-bot: Uploaded full log bundle: s3://redwood-logs/canary/2099012345/log-bundle.tar.gz :eyes:

Alex K: Maria, can you run an offline perf diff between v2.4.0-canary and v2.4.0-pinned on a representative g5.2x host? Need latency distribution and top failure signatures. Also check router config for missing model pin.

Maria L: running perf now, will paste results in ~10m. Also checking router pin logic.

Irina S: FYI I'm oncall for the next handoff window; can take ownership if needed. Recommend rollback if customer errors > 2% persist after 15m.

Sam T: perf run results (local repro on g5.2x):
- v2.4.0-pinned: p50 45ms, p95 220ms
- v2.4.0-canary: p50 48ms, p95 750ms (heavy tail)
Trace shows kernel_fallback triggering at sequence lengths > 1024.

Maria L: confirmed — q3a changes KV layout/attention ordering causing more cache misses; with kernel fallback we hit the slower code path, explaining the p95 tail.

Alex K: Customer impact assessment: Hosted API ~2% traffic to canary -> estimated ~60 failing requests/min, affecting 3 enterprise tenants. Notifying CSMs now.

Jordan P: Sent note to affected CSMs and queued a staged status update. No public incident page yet.

Alex K: Roll decision options (discuss here):
- Roll forward with a safety fix (remove q3a / force kernel) — needs a build.
- Roll back canary to v2.4.0-pinned — fastest mitigation.
- Temporarily rate-limit canary traffic to 1% and monitor.

Irina S: Recommend rollback — lowest blast radius and fastest to restore customer experience. I'll prepare the router pin change.

Sam T: Rollback plan: update routing tag canary -> v2.4.0-pinned via routemgr, run healthchecks. Est time ~6m.

Alex K: Execute rollback. @deploy-bot kick it off and post progress.

deploy-bot: Starting change: set model_router/canary -> v2.4.0-pinned. ChangeID: change-2099012345-1

deploy-bot: Applying to us-west-2 canary hosts (15 hosts):
- host apply i-0abc -> success
- host apply i-0def -> success
- host apply i-0f12 -> success
...

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 2099012402. ChangeID: change-2099012345-1. Healthchecks: 15/15 hosts OK.

Alex K: Metrics check: p95 back to baseline within 2m of rollback. Error rate dropped to <0.1%. Confirmed.

Sam T: Post-rollback logs show kernel_fallback warnings gone. Example:
```
2026-05-03T12:40:02Z INFO inferer: model v2.4.0-pinned OK p95=210ms
```

Maria L: Action items (captured):
- [ ] Revert quant_profile q3a until KV interactions tested (owner: Maria L)
- [ ] Add explicit kernel pinning to canary configs to avoid auto_fallback (owner: Eng Runtime)
- [ ] Default canary traffic cap of 1% (owner: Alex K)
- [ ] Full RCA doc with timeline, logs, and repro (owner: Irina S)

Irina S: I'll own the RCA write-up. Will collect timeline + logs into internal doc and share here by EOD. Also will verify router and deployment tooling for model pin enforcement.

Jordan P: Customer comms: notified affected customers that issue is mitigated; will provide postmortem after internal RCA.

Alex K: Closing: rollback successful, customer impact limited but meaningful. Do not reintroduce q3a until RCA complete. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Irina S: RCA link (when ready): https://docs.internal/rca/2099012345-canary-quant-kernel

Sam T: Final log bundle: s3://redwood-logs/canary/2099012345/finalized-logs.tar.gz

Alex K: Handoff to Irina for the write-up. I'm unassigning oncall. :white_check_mark:
